proposals.before: When Liu Zan died, aide Yan Shou emptied the commandery treasury for tribute and became vice minister of justice.
proposals.after: When Liu Zan died, aide Yan Shou emptied the commandery treasury for tribute and became a Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice.
proposals.reason: 刑部員外郎 is a Yuanwailang (Vice Director) post, not the Vice Minister (侍郎) rank.

proposals.before: Wang Sui and Li Chong, famed extortionists, were sent to rich Xuan-She and Zhexi to raise revenue.
proposals.after: Wang Sui and Li Xiao, famed extortionists, were sent to rich Xuan-She and Zhexi to raise revenue.
proposals.reason: 李翛 is Li Xiao (翛), not Chong; the idiomatic spelling mismatches the Chinese name.

proposals.before: The Minister of Agriculture Wang Sui and the Prefect of Jingzhao Li Chong were famed for gathering wealth and were made observation commissioners of Xuan-She and Zhexi, given rich territories to handle fiscal levies.
proposals.after: The Minister of Agriculture Wang Sui and the Prefect of Jingzhao Li Xiao were famed for gathering wealth and were made observation commissioners of Xuan-She and Zhexi, given rich territories to handle fiscal levies.
proposals.reason: 李翛 should be romanized Li Xiao, matching the Chinese characters.

proposals.before: Under Yizong, Nanzhao raids drove troops south to Lingnan.
proposals.after: Under Yizong, Yunnan barbarians repeatedly raided inward, and troops were shifted to garrison Lingnan.
proposals.reason: Chinese 雲南蠻 means Yunnan barbarians; the idiomatic rendering invents the specific polity name Nanzhao, which is not in the source.

proposals.before: Besieged at Fengxiang by Liang forces, Zhaozong ate gruel while the court starved; the city turned to cannibalism.
proposals.after: Zhaozong was at Fengxiang, besieged by Liang troops; in the city people ate one another, fathers eating their sons, while the Son of Heaven ate gruel; the six palaces and the imperial clan mostly starved to death.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits fathers eating sons and that the six palaces and imperial clan mostly starved to death, collapsing distinct source details.

decisions.reason: Chinese 刑部員外郎 is a yuanwailang (Vice Director) post in the Ministry of Justice; vice minister would be 侍郎. The replacement correctly restores that rank while leaving the rest of the sentence unchanged.
The personal name 李翛 is Li Xiao (翛 = xiāo), not Chong; the idiomatic 'Li Chong' misreads the character, and 'Li Xiao' restores the correct romanization.
Same unit as r0002: 李翛 must be Li Xiao in the literal field; replacing 'Li Chong' corrects the romanization without other changes.
Source has 雲南蠻數內寇 (Yunnan barbarians repeatedly raided inward) and 徙兵戍嶺南 (troops shifted to garrison Lingnan); 'Nanzhao' is not in the Chinese and invents a specific polity name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 雲南蠻數內寇，徙兵戍嶺南

decisions.reason: Chinese states 城中人相食，父食其子 and 六宮及宗室多餓死 as distinct facts beside the emperor eating gruel; the prior idiomatic collapsed these, and the proposed text restores them accurately.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 城中人相食，父食其子，而天子食粥，六宮及宗室多餓死

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0002/r0003 show English Li Chong came only from the bad rendering of 李翛; the personal-name claim must read Li Xiao while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
